Title: General Availability: Content Protection for Azure Media Services

Body.Content: Content Protection for Azure Media Services is now generally available and backed by the full support of the Azure Service-Level Agreement (SLA) for all customers. We understand the importance of protecting your premium media content. Our robust offering features static and dynamic encryption with first-party PlayReady license delivery and an AES 128-bit key delivery service. Customers can dynamically encrypt during delivery or statically encrypt during the content processing workflow, and our Content Protection options are available for live and on-demand workflows. General availability pricing will take effect on March 1, 2015. For more information, please visit the Media Services page, the Media Services Content Protection blog post, and the Securing Media page on MSDN. For a comprehensive look at pricing, please visit the Media Services Pricing page.
